Respected teachers and my dear classmates, I am standing here as a candidate for Class Representative not for power but for responsibility. If you elect me as your CR, my first promise is that I will become the bridge between students and teachers. I will ensure that every homework, notice and exam date is shared on time in our group so that no student, especially those who are absent, misses anything. I will maintain discipline not by shouting or writing names on the board to impress teachers, but with mutual respect and cooperation, because I believe respect gives respect and there will be no favouritism for anyone whether you are my friend or not. I will work for academic support for all by starting a peer help system where toppers will help weak students and I will request our teachers for proper doubt sessions and revision time before exams so we can fight our maths trauma together. I also promise to maintain cleanliness with a fair weekly duty chart and to uphold our class culture which is truly goated, making our class the best in discipline and behaviour. Finally, class 8th comes only once, so apart from studies I will also request for extra games periods and small celebrations to make this year memorable and ensure every talent like singing, drawing and lyricism gets a chance. I am not saying I am the best, but I promise I will listen to you and stand with you whether you feel stressed or guilt trapped, so please give me one chance to serve our class with honesty and dedication.

## MY MANIFESTO

If elected as your CR, my focus will be on representation, communication and a better class environment.

1. Everyone's Voice

Every student should have the opportunity to share their concerns, suggestions and ideas. I will make sure genuine class issues are communicated properly.

2. Clear Communication

Important announcements, deadlines, schedule changes and faculty updates should reach everyone clearly and on time.

3. Student–Faculty Communication

I will work as a proper communication bridge between students and teachers so that concerns can be presented respectfully and effectively.

4. Suggestions Matter

I will encourage useful ideas from the class and, wherever practical, try to take them forward through the proper channels.

5. Fair Representation

No favourites. No unnecessary bias. Whether you are my close friend or someone I barely know, your concern deserves to be heard.

6. Academics + Class Life

From study-related coordination to class activities, I will try to keep our class organised while also making college life more enjoyable and engaging.
7. A CR You Can Approach

You shouldn't feel that you need a reason or a special connection to talk to your CR. If something matters to you, you can bring it to me.

MY PROMISE

I won't promise things that are beyond my control.

I will promise something more important:

I will listen.
I will communicate.
I will take responsibility.
And I will genuinely try to represent our class.

Vote for representation. Vote for responsibility.
Vote for Abu Rehan Siddiqui.
